arms.a_contrast: native run to the answer row's logits; consumer = margin between the answer row's top-2 logits. W_O A_h (computed from o_parts; symbols.py unchanged). Per source row: sums over layers and heads; the rank of t0 by |value| among all rows under both forms.
arms.b_first_word: replace only the prompt's first word 'The' by 'A', 'In', 'Which' (3 variants); plus one exploratory variant 'A' at the start of BOTH shot lines (labelled exploratory, not judged). Re-tokenised, native run, argmax at the answer row.
arms.c_sink_cuts: at the answer row only, all 28 layers, all heads: zero cut of t0 (p[., 0] = 0, no renormalise) and mask cut of t0 (s[., 0] = -1e4, softmax recomputed natively). Measured: native margin change (fixed top-2 tokens), argmax. Closed forms (P09) checked at one layer L* (largest |sum_h share_t0|) with single-layer cuts: predicted c . Delta o_L* = -sum_h share_t0[h] (zero) and sum_h -contrast_t0[h] / (1 - p_t0[h]) (mask), against the measured c . (o_edit - o_native) at L* (exact up to bf16, since L*'s input at the answer row is unchanged).
arms.baseline: random non-sink rows (not t0, not descriptor span, not the answer row) cut at matched mass: per (layer, head), rows drawn in a seeded random order until their summed p reaches p_t0 for that head (all available if short; achieved mass ratio reported); zero and mask versions, all layers.

metrics.follows_first_word: default items: argmax at the answer row == the first token of ' ' + new first word
metrics.default_kept: default items: argmax is still ' The' (or the variant's own default)
metrics.correct_unchanged: correct items: argmax unchanged under each first-word variant
metrics.cut_moves_default: default items: argmax != ' The' after the cut
metrics.cut_moves_correct: correct items: argmax changes after the cut
metrics.closed_form_error: |predicted - measured| at L*, against 2 bf16 spacings of the measured value
